<thought>To obtain the desired template, I will search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic transformation that breaks a nitro group and forms an amine. I will use a simple nitro‑aromatic SMILES (c1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]) as the target molecule for the search. This should return templates that perform nitro‑to‑amine reduction. Once I have the template ID, I can retrieve its mapped reaction SMILES.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "c1ccc(cc1)[N+](=O)[O-]",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amine"],
    "limit": 1
}</action_input>
